text:
sam: FYI noticed a cluster of missing attributions in last night's ingest run — looks tied to short-lived fanout workers dropping ephemeral tokens.
morgan: logs?
sam: reconciler warn: `missing_provenance token=0x7f3a... fanout_id=ephemeral-7321`. traces show fanout ACK returned before provenance write completed.
anya: so workers ack upstream too early?
sam: yes — ack on enqueue to fanout queue, provenance write is async to audit topic; if worker dies, lineage lost.
chen: saw similar in staging — late arrivals produce tombstones/orphaned credits. Options: 1) synchronous provenance write on enqueue (adds ~50-100ms) OR 2) idempotent reconcile/backfill job (delayed accuracy).
morgan: any hybrid idea?
chen: hybrid: write a tiny, canonical fingerprint synchronously (small payload), emit full provenance async. fingerprint used for quick dedupe and backfill.
anya: fingerprint must be stable — token_checksum varies with normalization. need canonicalize+fp.
sam: +observability: metric `fanout_ack_before_provenance` with tags (model, region, worker_ver).
metering-bot: alert: orphaned-token events +3.2x in us-west1 between 03:00-05:00 UTC.
morgan: hybrid keeps SLOs but widens billing accuracy window. finance will want deterministic final state.
anya: suggest reconciliation SLA: final attribution within 24h, keep audit trail of fingerprint + full provenance when available, and emit `provenance_missing` flag for queries.
chen: impl sketch: `fp = fp(canonicalize(payload))` sync write to custody topic (tiny), then enqueue full provenance async to audit topic (at-least-once). Backfill subscribes to custody to reconcile.
sam: collision risk? namespace by tenant_id+created_at+fp as composite key to reduce risk.
anya: agreed — composite key makes collisions negligible.
morgan: rollout?
sam: spike in staging to add fingerprint write + metric for 48h, then 10% traffic canary, run dry-run backfill and compare ledger deltas.
chen: I'll draft a short RFC with perf numbers and cost estimate for extra sync writes + backfill compute.
anya: ping finance/legal on SLA/audit wording.
morgan: SGTM :thumbsup:
sam: cool — I'll open RFC + PR for the staging spike.
